Today I took one loss of 200 and tried to find a setup later on in the day, but never got the entry I needed.
,
Market opened and we started making moves down and after 15mins into market open, es took asian lows while nq didn’t. We also had an smt on the 5min where nq formed a 2 candle rejection block and I entered off of it. We swept premarket liquidity so there was el too and it looked like a good trade, but price clearly wanted to go lower because I got stopped out instantly. I don’t think it was a bad trade, I think the problem is that I identified it as the wrong manipulation leg as price obviously wanted to manipulate lower. (Screenshot 1)
,

I didn’t take it because I wanted an entry trigger, but we made a 60pt rb out of it which is very hard to trade. 10:00 opened and we started consolidating and I was looking for trades out of that 60pt 5min rb, but the stop losses were just too big and I never found a valid entry. (Screenshot 2 & 3)
,

Even though I read price well today and we got a huge pump for the rest of the session I took a loss. It will all balance out though and my next win will cover everything and more so just keep doing what I’m doing and it will work out.
